notes.title: Purple Island: new map + global travel + main quest changes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790848/13ca66bc9e6add0a93c6c2cd671f4a2d7ac7d469.png[/img]
You'll need to complete first episode and get your ID card to enable global travel. After that - just talk to the ferry to get your ticket. Travel by ferry is time consuming, route to Purple Island will take 6 hours of game time. 
Right now, travel is free of charge, but we will change it as soon as we add some grindy job in the new area. 

[b]Not enough jumping power? Yes, but:[/b]
You will be able to increase that, we are working on level up system. Level 1 strength is right on the edge to jump over the blocks in Purple Island area. That's annoying, but that's annoying for reason - for  character development to be valuable.

[b]Save frequently[/b]
Purple Island is work in progress, you can and you will stuck. 
Use more than one save, new objects might be placed on top of your saved position. Take care.

notes.title: Content update: crate delivery job, movable teleports and springs
notes.notes:
New NPC in the port location will now has job for you: container delivery.
You can repeat quest as many times as you want, to collect required amount of money. Regular quests are more profitable, though. Why? We need some kind of grind before adding trade, otherwise the player might not have enough money to complete the main quest. Number of crates to deliver and target places will vary every time.
Notice, that with crate in your hands you can't use ladders, so you might need to find new path between locations. 

Or, build your own pathway. For that we have movable teleports and movable springs, which will shoot you in the air.
